description: Uso y acceso a las zonas wifi del Meta is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Meta, Meta. Datos de las conexiones realizadas por los usuarios a las zonas wifi ubicadas en los diferentes municipios del departamento administradas por la Gobernación del Meta. Coverage: Gobernación de Meta, Meta. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Meta, Meta. Its tags are zonas wifi, meta, municipio, internet. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Función pública. The portal shows 2020-12-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
